original_requirement: Design only a fail-open, privacy-safe raw Provider shape, raw-to-normalized delta, and PTR9 guard-decision observer that closes the PTR11 observability gap without changing production behavior.
closed_world_justification: The design binds the sealed PTR11 evidence, exact current source owners, existing trace envelope, adapter protocols, PTR9 predicate, capability write, and Contract Runtime recovery/classification flow. No execution or source modification is authorized.
operational_definition: At adapter ingress capture metadata-only raw structure; after normalization compare shapes; at the existing guard snapshot every predicate and write outcome; at Contract Runtime complete route/fail-close/output-limit disposition under the same trace identity.
why_not_fixed: PTR12 is design-only. The observability gap remains in production until a separately authorized PTR13 implementation and offline validation.
forbidden_narrowing: No Boundary 12, DeepSeek, provider, or model hardcoding
No widening of PTR9 predicate or scope
No Prompt, Model, Route, Retry, Fallback, Budget, Validator, Canon, StoryState, or READY change
No claim that observer repairs Short or Call 1 semantics
